headline: In Danbury, some are hiding from ICE. Others are following them.
summary: In Danbury, CT, ICE raids from Aug. 23-27 targeted immigrant communities, causing fear and disruption among families. Local officials struggled to balance support for immigrants with avoiding federal retaliation. Mayor Alves, once undocumented himself, faced criticism for not doing more but prioritized safety over confrontation. Activists demanded stronger action while businesses urged caution.
